## Detailed Plan

### 1. Goal Command Prompt Cache Preservation (MEDIUM ~4-6h)

**What**: Kilocode PR #14680 keeps goal tool schemas stable across goal turns, preserving provider prompt cache and avoiding schema regeneration cost per iteration. Alexi's `src/command/goal.ts` currently calls `agenticChat()` inside the goal loop (L144-176) without caching tool schemas, so each turn may regenerate schemas and invalidate the prompt cache breakpoint.

**Why**: Goal loops with many turns waste tokens/cost/latency by invalidating prompt cache on each iteration. Cache preservation is HIGH IMPACT for goal users.

**How**:
- Cache tool schemas at goal start (before the turn loop begins)
- Pass frozen schemas to all `agenticChat()` calls inside the goal loop via options/context
- Verify prompt cache hit rate improves across goal turns in integration test
- Add test case for goal loop with 5+ turns checking `cache_read_input_tokens` increases after turn 1

**Files**:
- `src/command/goal.ts` (L130-263, main goal loop)
- `src/core/agenticChat.ts` (tool schema generation and options)
- `tests/command/goal.test.ts` (new test for cache preservation)

**Done when**:
- [ ] Tool schemas cached before goal loop starts
- [ ] Frozen schemas passed to all `agenticChat()` calls in loop
- [ ] Integration test verifies `cache_read_input_tokens` increases after turn 1 in multi-turn goal
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green
- [ ] Coverage >= 40%

### 2. Linux TUI Glyph Font Compatibility Audit (LOW ~2-3h)

**What**: Cline PR #14686 replaces U+23F5 (missing from Linux monospace fonts) with U+25B6 (widely supported). Alexi TUI (`src/cli/tui/`) uses various Unicode glyphs (spinners, status indicators, borders) but has NOT been audited for Linux monospace font coverage. Glyphs missing from DejaVu Sans Mono / JetBrains Mono render as tofu (empty box).

**Why**: Linux UX degradation when glyphs are missing from common terminal fonts. Low priority (cosmetic), but affects readability.

**How**:
- Audit TUI code under `src/cli/tui/` for Unicode glyphs outside ASCII range U+0020-U+007E
- Check glyph coverage in DejaVu Sans Mono and JetBrains Mono via Unicode font charts
- Replace missing glyphs with widely supported alternatives from U+2500-U+257F Box Drawing / U+25A0-U+25FF Geometric Shapes
- Add platform-specific fallback via `process.platform === 'linux' ? FALLBACK_GLYPH : PREFERRED_GLYPH` pattern where needed
- Test on Linux VM with DejaVu Sans Mono

**Files**:
- `src/cli/tui/components/StatusIcon.tsx` (U+23F8 pause, U+25D0 spinner fallback - already checked)
- `src/cli/tui/dialogs/FilePicker.tsx` (U+2713 checkmark, U+2717 cross, U+25B8 triangle)
- `src/cli/tui/dialogs/RewindDialog.tsx` (U+25B8 triangle)
- `src/cli/tui/dialogs/ModelPicker.tsx` (U+25CF/U+25CB filled/empty circle, U+26A0 warning)
- `src/cli/tui/components/MessageBubble.tsx` (U+2500 box drawing)
- `src/cli/tui/components/Header.tsx` (box drawing characters)
- `tests/cli/tui/glyphs.test.ts` (new test for glyph compatibility)

**Done when**:
- [ ] All TUI glyphs audited for Linux font coverage
- [ ] Missing glyphs replaced or platform-specific fallbacks added
- [ ] Test verifies glyphs exist in DejaVu Sans Mono / JetBrains Mono Unicode ranges
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green
- [ ] Manual test on Linux VM confirms no tofu rendering

### 3. Content-Filter Finish Reason (carry-forward, HIGH ~3-4h)

**What**: Cline commit adds `finishReason === 'content-filter'` check to skip retries when content policy violations occur. Alexi's provider layer does not distinguish content-filter from other errors, so content policy violations trigger wasteful retries.

**Why**: High reach (all users), prevents wasted tokens/cost/latency on non-retriable content policy failures.

**How**:
- Add `finishReason === 'content-filter'` check in provider response handling
- Skip retries and surface user-friendly message when content-filter detected
- Add telemetry for content-filter occurrences
- Tests for content-filter finish reason handling

**Files**:
- `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` (finish reason handling)
- `src/core/error-backoff.ts` (add content-filter to permanent error classification)
- `tests/providers/content-filter.test.ts` (new test)

**Done when**:
- [ ] `finishReason === 'content-filter'` check added to provider layer
- [ ] Retries skipped for content-filter finish reason
- [ ] User message surfaced when content-filter occurs
- [ ] Telemetry tracks content-filter occurrences
- [ ] Tests verify content-filter handling
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green

### 4. Scheduled Session Status Display (carry-forward, MEDIUM ~2-3h)

**What**: Kilocode shows wake time for scheduled sessions in CLI/TUI. Alexi session manager tracks scheduled sessions but does not display wake time in CLI output.

**Why**: Medium reach (scheduled session users), medium impact (UX visibility for when sessions will resume).

**How**:
- Add wake time display to session list output
- Format relative time ("in 2h 15m") and absolute time (ISO-8601)
- TUI session list dialog shows wake time for scheduled sessions

**Files**:
- `src/core/sessionManager.ts` (session metadata for scheduled sessions)
- `src/cli/commands/sessions.ts` (CLI output formatting)
- `src/cli/tui/dialogs/SessionList.tsx` (TUI session list)
- `tests/cli/commands/sessions.test.ts` (test scheduled session display)

**Done when**:
- [ ] CLI `sessions` command shows wake time for scheduled sessions
- [ ] TUI session list shows wake time with relative + absolute formatting
- [ ] Tests verify wake time display formatting
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green

### 5. Prompt Cache Breakpoint Gating (carry-forward, MEDIUM ~2-3h)

**What**: Kilocode adds endpoint detection to distinguish first-party OpenAI from custom OpenAI endpoints, gating prompt cache breakpoint insertion. Alexi does not distinguish endpoint type, so custom OpenAI endpoints may receive prompt cache breakpoints they don't support.

**Why**: Medium reach (custom OpenAI endpoint users), medium impact (prevent cache breaks on unsupported endpoints).

**How**:
- Add endpoint detection (first-party vs custom OpenAI)
- Gate prompt cache breakpoint insertion on first-party endpoints only
- Tests for endpoint detection and breakpoint gating

**Files**:
- `src/providers/index.ts` (endpoint detection)
- `src/core/orchestrator.ts` (prompt cache breakpoint logic)
- `tests/providers/cache-gating.test.ts` (new test)

**Done when**:
- [ ] Endpoint detection distinguishes first-party vs custom OpenAI
- [ ] Prompt cache breakpoints only inserted for first-party endpoints
- [ ] Tests verify breakpoint gating logic
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green
